d: I got messaged by someone asking about how they can support someone on Fantia not too long after the last Panimi gallery. After thinking about it, I felt like it would make the most amount of sense to create an easily accessible guide as to how I was able to support folks on Fantia, that way, you guys can do the same. I apologize if things look messy and if I wasn't too clear on somethings, but I still hope that this was useful either way!
n: [Non-H] [TheDoise20XX] How to support creators on Fantia using SeaGM
